Mumbai, November 1, 2026: 
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd. recorded sales of 75,426 units in the domestic and 
international markets in October 2026, compared to 61,295 units in October 2025, representing a 
healthy growth of 23% year-on-year.
